boundaries.implementation: Leave uncontacted outer faces without electrodes; verify native mesh contact areas and solver boundary inventory.
boundaries.uncontacted_faces: Homogeneous natural Neumann electrostatic potential boundary (zero normal potential derivative) and zero normal electron/hole current; no artificial z electrodes.

source_drain.reference_window: Closed Polygon; corner order (xmin,0,zmin),(xmin,0,zmax),(xmax,0,zmax),(xmax,0,zmin),repeat first; right-hand normal +y; Positive placement.

doping.transport_rule: Electrical dopants do not add Geant4 material species in this representative model. Transport uses the declared bulk Si and SiO2.
doping.z_rule: Lateral Gaussian decays only outside the primary domain (Smesh UG p182). The polygon spans the complete z width, so the inherited xy analytical profile is constant in z inside silicon. Native mesh slice verification is still required.

geometry.material_density_status: Nominal standard material values for the shared geometric model; actual Geant4 material inventory must match before using transport output.
geometry.material_scope: Only explicit Si and gate oxide solids; contacts are ideal boundary conditions with zero volume, not metal layers. No unmodelled BEOL, passivation, capacitor body, polysilicon gate or surrounding package is inferred.
geometry.status: representative extruded geometry; not a calibrated commercial DRAM or a 90 nm model

scope: Fixed natural nuclear witness stages in the identical representative device geometry; no rate inference
step_limit_scope: all declared device solids; charged particles only
world_rule: Origin-centred vacuum cuboid: max absolute entity coordinate + 10 um per axis
